title: NCAA denies Texas Tech's appeal regarding Brendan Sorsby's eligibility

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NCAA denies Texas Tech's appeal regarding Brendan Sorsby's eligibility
sources.description: As a judge weighs whether to reinstate the eligibility of Texas Tech quarterback Brendan Sorsby, the NCAA has reiterated its decision that Sorsby's gambling habits prevent him from playing again.
